title: vllm-neuron-parity run state (run-state.json)
description: Single shape authority for a vllm-neuron-parity run's persisted state, realizing the state contract of workflow.pave.yaml (pave.state). The required list mirrors pave.state.required exactly. State points; artifacts prove: fields hold positions, statuses, counters, pins, and artifact paths - never artifact content. The lead is the only writer (P10) and checkpoints after every consequential transition (pave.state.checkpoint). No prose anywhere restates this field list.

workflow_identity.description: Run identity plus the frozen revision this instance is pinned to. Recorded and verified at run start; a mid-run manifest change does not move a running instance.

pinned_release.description: Frozen at intake - the single pin authority for the run. Values are run inputs; the graph never names them. Null before intake freezes them.

requested_targets.description: The targets requested at intake, in the form the user stated them.

instance_roster.description: Hardware instance types available to the run, frozen at intake.

cross_run_artifact_refs.description: Paths of the four cross-run artifacts, loaded at intake and updated only by the lead's serialized writes at campaign closure. An absent fingerprint file reads as a legitimate empty set, never an error.

ranked_backlog.description: Path of the ranked backlog artifact under the route_costing_and_backlog evidence directory, which is the authority for entries and their order; null before ranking.

approved_campaigns.description: Fan-out collection - one entry per gate-1-approved campaign.

kickoff_contract.description: Path of this campaign's kickoff-contract record.

campaign_states.description: Pointer per campaign, keyed by campaign id, to its own state and evidence directory (one file per event); never inlined into run state.

campaign_target_pins.description: Per-campaign target base, keyed by campaign id - equals the run's frozen pinned_release for backport-route campaigns, the kickoff-declared upgrade base for upgrade-route campaigns. Values are run inputs, never graph text.

scheduling_holds.description: Per-campaign predicted file surfaces and the serialization holds the lead derives from them; re-derived under the lead's standing scheduling authority whenever a campaign design refines its predicted surface.

held_by.description: Campaign ids this campaign waits on.

exclusive.description: True for an upgrade-route campaign that holds all others while it runs.

comparator_registrations.description: Per-campaign committed comparator registration, keyed by campaign id - the lead's commitment entry that acceptance_preregistered consumes. Points at the acceptance_preregistration artifact; the artifact is the content authority.

hardware_attempt_counts.description: Per-target shared budget across all routes that spend hardware attempts, keyed by target; the tier-2 breaker reads it at every 10.

hardware_lease_record.description: The lead-only lease record: a pointer to the one-file-per-event record directory plus the current holder per leased host. Null before any lease.

gate_approval_records.description: Verbatim user decisions at gates 1, 2, and 3, one entry per decision; the recorded artifact holds the verbatim text.

active_node_runs.description: Open node instances - one entry per dispatched seat that has not yet returned a declared outcome. Retired when its node instance closes.

seat.description: Named teammate seat handle for this node instance.

completed_outcomes.description: The run's traversal and event history: one append-only entry per consequential transition, written at every checkpoint. Each entry names the node, the single declared outcome taken, and the evidence keys that back it.

evidence.description: Keys of evidence_references entries produced or consumed by this transition.

evidence_references.description: Evidence index: each key is an evidence id declared in workflow.pave.yaml's evidence block; each value is the artifact path, or the list of per-campaign paths, that realizes it. Paths only - never content.

open_questions.description: Open risks, discoveries, and unresolved questions preserved for closure; carried forward, never silently dropped.

terminal_classification.description: The run's honest terminal classification. status mirrors the terminal_status values declared by the graph's control endpoints; null while the run is live or paused.

endpoint.description: The control endpoint id the run reached.

scan_entry_id.description: Minted by the lead at each entry into the scan boundary and stamped into grant files and report metadata; settlement refuses to run without it. Re-trace grants are counted under scan-entry ids, never a stored integer.

design_entry_id.description: Minted by the lead at each entry into the design boundary and stamped into every design-lap artifact; serves the screen progress detector and the record_incomplete detector. The record assembler refuses to run without it.

discrepant_campaigns.description: Derived per run-closure verification round from the current run_closure_verdict - the campaigns whose claimed closure failed first-hand verification; the closure_unverified fan-out reads it. Never stored independently of the verdict record.

deficient_targets.description: Derived per assembly round from the run-level delta index - the named targets whose reports fail the costing-sufficiency rubric with re-trace bound unexhausted; the reports_insufficient fan-out reads it. Never stored independently of the index.

notes.description: Free-form prose home for anything the fields above do not carry. Intentionally unconstrained.
